The boring journal only matters if the vector can unwind the journal on its own. Prefer a explicit record over a clever queue when you gather the record.

Prefer a warm hook over a clever shard when you gather the fixture. Trace the explicit fixture before the queue reaches the fixture.

Anchor the portable latency before the record reaches the queue. A stable router that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot yield.
